scope: Author static source-byte inspection only; no Rust parsing, compilation, formatting, runtime test, host action or performance result.
hash_state_invariant: reference Some implies hash None; reference None implies hash Some. self is immutable for the whole call; Context initialization is infallible and no unwrap/expect or new reachable early return is added.
buffer_invariant: The fixed initialized [u8;16384] is borrowed mutably for one synchronous verify only; one Profile::verify_files_checked call owns it across six sequential file reads. No cross-await/thread/global or worker-to-owner state transfer.
initialization_order_delta: Pure local scratch zero-initialization moves to wrapper/sweep entry before the first existing check_current. All existing check_current statements and their order relative to fallible file/read/final/content operations are unchanged. Already-expired calls may pay this initialization before rejection; no timing neutrality claim.
preserved: fresh open flags/path semantics, reference budget/content pins, maximum+1 Take, count-limited buffer use, non-short-circuit mismatch comparison, Interrupted branch, EOF, all existing error strings, verify_read and policy/shell/boundary order; pool/validation/cancellation/registry code untouched.
assembly_note: One oversized local metadata writer was rejected before process creation with E2BIG. Small create-only writers then saved exact source bytes and generated the diff. No Rust/test/host process was started.
